rows.jyutping: dat6 jin4 do1 zo2 hou2 do1
rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when something suddenly becomes much more numerous.

example.english: Whenever there is news of an infectious disease, rumours proliferate online.
example.traditional: 一有傳染病消息，網上嘅謠言就突然多咗好多。
example.jyutping: jat1 jau5 cyun4 jim5 beng6 siu1 sik1 mong5 soeng6 ge3 jiu4 jin4 zau6 dat6 jin4 do1 zo2 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this when the increase involves spreading across an area, especially for problems, disease, fire, or bad habits.

example.english: This bad habit can proliferate quickly from person to person.
example.traditional: 呢種壞習慣一傳十、十傳百，好快就蔓延開去。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 waai6 zaap6 gwaan3 jat1 cyun4 sap6 sap6 cyun4 baak3 hou2 faai3 zau6 maan6 jin4 hoi1 heoi3

rows.note: Use this for living things multiplying or reproducing in large numbers.

example.english: The mosquitoes at home proliferate rapidly every summer.
example.traditional: 屋企啲蚊一到夏天就繁殖得好快。
example.jyutping: uk1 kei2 di1 man1 jat1 dou3 haa6 tin1 zau6 faan4 zik6 dak1 hou2 faai3
